principle: No text carries the explanation; persistent geometry and camera attention carry it.

frames.name: question-space
frames.visual: a dark empty six-dimensional question space represented by a luminous closed shell with a missing seam

frames.name: torus-garden
frames.visual: a family of identical blue torus organisms suspended along a curved path, each visibly the same object at a different position
frames.meaning: a smooth family of complex two-tori

frames.name: three-boundaries
frames.visual: three distinct gates on the path: two rotating colored gates and one widening golden cusp gate

frames.name: cusp-collapse
frames.visual: one torus passes through the golden cusp, twists, opens along its cycles and becomes a six-sided amber crystal surface
frames.meaning: unipotent monodromy and dP6 toric degeneration

frames.name: closure
frames.visual: the six-sided surface folds its boundary seams into a luminous closed sphere while the original path remains visible behind it
frames.meaning: the total space closes with the homology of S6

deterministic_translation.camera_rule: one subject per frame; hold before move; transition only after the viewer can name the visible relation

falsifier: If a viewer cannot infer the transformation from geometry without reading text, the frame is rejected and regenerated.
